items.text: Christian McCaffrey (thigh) is questionable to return. He's been in the medical tent for several minutes.

items.implication: SF's lead back may miss time or more; impacts game script for ATL (JD's Bijan Robinson).
items.opportunity: None direct; monitor for any SF RB promotion if CMC out long.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive vs Dolphins after limited practice and early return attempt.
items.why: Hasn't been full participant; sources said unlikely, confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Jets backfield shifts to other options; Hall misses another game.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Lamar OUT; Puka GTD/optimism; Breece GTD/pessimism then inactive; Saquon expected; Smith/Wicks OUT; Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN.

items.text: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley to start.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley start elevates Zay Flowers target share; Ravens pass game less dual-threat.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Flowers and Likely/Andrews.

items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, questionable) will play vs Raiders; feeling better Saturday, no setbacks expected.
items.why: Calf minor per reports; better Saturday, team confident if no setbacks. Pregame workout likely.
items.implication: High-upside WR1 if active in favorable spot; monitor 90-min inactives.
items.opportunity: Full target share if clears; Adams already IR.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans.
items.why: Sources confirm lead back return.
items.implication: Primary carries/snaps in NYG backfield.
items.opportunity: RB2/flex volume.

items.implication: Committee or lead potential in MIN backfield.
items.opportunity: RB flex/handcuff value.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) questionable but expected to play Monday vs Cowboys; DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT.
items.why: Full practice Saturday after limited; sources expect return.
items.implication: RB1 upside vs soft Dallas run D; PHI pass game thinner without Smith/Wicks.
items.opportunity: Volume spike for Barkley; secondary WRs elevate.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled OUT for Monday vs Cowboys; Dontayvion Wicks also OUT.
items.why: Final injury report designation.
items.implication: Thinner PHI WR room; more volume to remaining pass-catchers and Barkley checkdowns.

items.implication: Potential target share in HOU offense; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Sneaky WR upside if featured.

items.implication: Lead back return; monitor workload post-absence.
items.opportunity: RB2/flex with goal-line work.

items.implication: Immediate roster add for DEN RB depth/opportunity.
items.opportunity: Emerging lead or committee share.

items.implication: Monitor return; if out rest of way, backup RB surge. Bye next week may influence.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, full opportunity to 49ers backup RBs; pregame Levitan tempted CMC slot WR role amid Evans/Deebo OUT.

items.text: Tyrone Tracy Jr. questionable to return with a hamstring injury.
items.signal: Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. questionable to return vs Texans with a hamstring injury.
items.why: Tracy was expected to split work with Cam Skattebo; a hamstring can linger.
items.implication: If he misses time, Skattebo's lead-back share grows and Devin Singletary takes more passing-down work.
items.opportunity: Watch Tracy's postgame status this week; Singletary could become a short-term flex add if Tracy misses games.

items.text: Christian McCaffey to the locker room.

items.why: Escalation of the already-published thigh injury; Kaelon Black has taken over and scored a 30-yard TD.
items.implication: Kaelon Black is the 49ers' lead back for the rest of the game, and longer if McCaffrey misses time.
items.opportunity: Kaelon Black is the pickup to check if McCaffrey's thigh costs him games; confirm availability in Yahoo before any move.

items.implication: Kirk is in JD's IR slot, so no lineup impact today; his role is worth tracking for next week.
items.opportunity: Hold Kirk; reassess after the game's snap and route share.

items.text: #Texans Woody Marks is in blue medical tent, went there under own power after having left leg examined. Only one healthy running back left on active GameDay roster today: Dare Ogunbowale
items.signal: Texans RB Woody Marks evaluated for a left leg injury in the 3rd quarter vs the Giants.
items.why: With David Montgomery inactive, Marks was the lead back; Ogunbowale is the only other healthy RB.
items.implication: If Marks misses time, the Texans backfield is wide open.
items.opportunity: Track Marks' diagnosis; a Texans RB could become a pickup.

items.text: Vikings RB Aaron Jones was taken out on a speed option run, and now the trainers are taking him into the medical tent.
items.signal: Vikings RB Aaron Jones into the medical tent in the 4th quarter vs the Colts.
items.why: No diagnosis yet.
items.implication: If Jones misses time, the Vikings' backup RB gains work.
items.opportunity: Monitor postgame update.

items.text: It appears Kenny Pickett is coming into the game.
items.signal: Panthers appear to replace Bryce Young with Kenny Pickett while trailing big vs Tampa Bay.
items.why: Young had two INTs and a fumble; Carolina trailed 43-6.
items.implication: Affects JD's Carolina pieces (McMillan, Waller) if it becomes a QB change.
items.opportunity: Watch for any QB announcement this week.

items.text: Jonah Coleman (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Cardinals. Via @Broncos
items.signal: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman active vs Arizona.
items.why: Berry flagged Coleman as a must-roster back after activation.
items.implication: His usage today shapes his waiver value.
items.opportunity: Check Coleman's snap share after the game; confirm Yahoo availability before any move.
